title: Storage unit form
purpose: Create a freezer, tank or other storage unit, or change the name, storage class or nominal temperature of an existing one.
summary: Create a freezer, tank or other storage unit, or change the name, storage class or nominal temperature of an existing one.

tasks.title: Create a unit
steps: Choose the [[Room]], type the [[Code]] and [[Name]], and choose [[Technology]] and [[Storage class]].
Enter [[Nominal temperature (°C)]] and select [[Create storage unit]]. Add racks from its page.

tasks.title: Change a unit
steps: Change the name, class or temperature, give the [[Reason for the change]] and select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: Room, code and technology cannot be changed later.
Codes are stored in capitals and never reused.
A retired unit cannot be edited.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin and manager roles can open or submit this form.
Nominal temperature is the unit's stated set point; it is not a measurement and never blocks storing an item. A retired unit cannot be edited.

items.label: Room
items.description: Create only. Required; active rooms, shown as site / room. Preselected when opened from a room page.

items.label: Code
items.description: Create only. Up to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. Stored in capitals. It can never be changed or reused, even after retirement.

items.label: Technology
items.description: Create only. LN2 vapor phase, LN2 liquid phase, Mechanical freezer or refrigerator, or Ambient.

items.label: Storage class
items.description: Required. Describes the storage conditions. New units offer active classes only; when editing, the unit's current class stays selectable even if it has since been deactivated.

items.label: Nominal temperature (°C)
items.description: Required exact decimal from -273.15 to 9999.99 with at most two decimal places, for example -160.00.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Edit only. Required, up to 2000 characters. Kept in the history.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Editing needs a reason (up to 2000 characters), which is kept in the history with the values before and after. Creating records the setup without asking for a reason. If the record changed since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay on the page, but check the current values before saving again. A save with nothing changed is refused.

items.label: Create storage unit / Save changes
items.description: Saves and opens the unit. A new unit has no racks yet; add them from its page.
